findings.subject: menu
findings.summary: The stable `menu` contract has no `atom63 component` answer, so its tone axis (neutral/primary) is undiscoverable to builders.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-1. `node packages/cli/src/bin.mjs component menu` at f7e5e419 -> component.not_found ("Did you mean: menubar, context-menu, dropdown-menu?"); packages/cli/generated/agent-index.json components list has no menu; packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/menu.json maturity stable, tones [neutral, primary]; the dropdown-menu/context-menu/menubar index entries contain no "tone".
findings.fix: Index `menu` as a recipe subject in the CLI (or fold its tone axis and states into the dropdown-menu/context-menu/menubar answers) and document how to pick the primary tone.

findings.subject: menu
findings.summary: The contract's tone axis has no typed prop; primary tone needs a raw data-tone attribute.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-2. menu.json tones; packages/ui-react/src/components/menu/menu.css:110-117 selects [data-tone='primary']; grep tone in dropdown-menu.tsx, context-menu.tsx, menubar.tsx: no matches; menu.stories.tsx sets data-tone by hand.
findings.fix: Add `tone?: 'neutral' | 'primary'` to DropdownMenuContent, ContextMenuContent, MenubarContent (and sub contents), mapped to data-tone, with the contract default.

findings.subject: dropdown-menu
findings.summary: Docs misdescribe the primary highlight token and omit the tone opt-in.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-6. apps/docs/src/pages/component-dropdown-menu.mdx:93 ("Selected/current row fill") vs packages/ui-react/src/components/menu/menu.css:110-117 (highlighted row under data-tone=primary only).
findings.fix: Describe --a63-menu-highlight-primary-* as the highlighted row under tone=primary and document the tone option.

findings.subject: breadcrumb
findings.summary: The collapsed composition hides levels behind a non-interactive ellipsis, so they cannot be reached.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-21. packages/ui-react/src/components/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.tsx:114-127 BreadcrumbEllipsis is a span with fixed English "More"; :22 aria-label="breadcrumb"; breadcrumb.stories.tsx Collapsed ships it bare (unchanged since r2).
findings.fix: Show the collapsed composition with the ellipsis as a DropdownMenuTrigger (button with an accessible name) listing the hidden levels, and make the 'More' label and nav label overridable/localizable.

findings.subject: breadcrumb
findings.summary: Breadcrumb has only a generated docs page.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-22. pnpm -s atom63 component breadcrumb: import line, boilerplate guidance.
findings.fix: Write component-breadcrumb.mdx covering collapsing, custom separators and localization of labels.

findings.subject: tabs
findings.summary: Disabled tabs are never designed in a story or captured (vertical now is).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-27. packages/ui-react/src/components/tabs/tabs.stories.tsx (no disabled tab); packages/ui-react/src/components/tabs/tabs.css:212-214 literal opacity 0.56.
findings.fix: Add a Disabled story to the baselines and read the disabled opacity from --a63-action-disabled-opacity.

findings.subject: tabs
findings.summary: Tabs are 28-32px tall on coarse pointers.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-28. tabs.css --tabs-height max(control-height-md, control-min-size, floor); default tab height minus 2x inset.
findings.fix: Expand the tab hit area to --a63-control-min-target vertically (pseudo-element), as Button does.

findings.subject: tabs
findings.summary: No test checks that a disabled tab is skipped by arrow keys (vertical orientation is now covered by the Vertical play).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-29. packages/ui-react/src/components/tabs/tabs.test.tsx:22-75 (5 tests); tabs.stories.tsx Vertical play covers orientation geometry.
findings.fix: Add a unit test that arrow keys skip a disabled tab.

findings.subject: tabs
findings.summary: The overflowing tab list has no edge cue besides a hard clip.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k05-30. apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-tabs-mobile-overflow-chromium-linux.png.
findings.fix: Add a scroll fade on the overflowing edge (as ScrollArea scrollFade).

findings.subject: menubar
findings.summary: Menubar has only a generated docs page: one specific guidance line, two group boilerplate lines and an import-only usage block.
findings.evidence: New in r3. `node packages/cli/src/bin.mjs component menubar` at f7e5e419 (Guidance: one menubar line + two lines shared with the navigation group; Usage: import line only); no apps/docs/src/pages/component-menubar.mdx. r2 scored K8=2 without a finding.
findings.fix: Write component-menubar.mdx with a runnable File/Edit/View example, when to use Menubar vs DropdownMenu, the keyboard model and the destructive item variant.
